comment: Furiah's Visuals: the Rune Blade's own clips (its swings and guard are the saber set's). reveal: the runes lit along the blade (0 none, 1 all; outside 0..1: all lit). flare: the runes and the gem flaring. leftAlong: the empty left fist on the blade's flat, from the guard toward the point. parts: gem turns about its own axis (on top of its slow idle turn). Every clip here is original to this mod.

rune_blade_rune_awakening.comment: Rune awakening: the sword is brought level across the view and its runes go dark; the left fist presses the flat by the guard and slides toward the point, the runes lighting one by one behind it; at the end they flare, and the sword returns to the hold.

rune_blade_gem_spin.comment: Gem spin: the sword is turned point down and its hilt raised, the ring pommel up beside the fist; the floating gem spins up, flaring, then slows back to its idle turn.
